_meta.note: All queries are comment-free. QuickNode SQL Explorer rejects SQL comments (--  /* */  #). Do not add comments inside the SQL strings. Verified against the live cluster.

validatorScorecard: WITH stake AS (SELECT validator, argMax(validator_total_delegated, snapshot_time) / 1e8 AS stake_hype, argMax(commission_bps, snapshot_time) AS commission_bps, COUNT(DISTINCT delegator) AS delegator_count FROM hyperliquid_delegator_rewards WHERE snapshot_time > now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR GROUP BY validator), rewards24 AS (SELECT validator, SUM(reward) AS reward_24h, SUM(CASE WHEN reward > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS earning_minutes, COUNT(*) AS total_minutes, MAX(block_time) AS last_seen FROM hyperliquid_validator_rewards WHERE block_time > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY validator), rewards1h AS (SELECT validator, SUM(reward) AS reward_1h FROM hyperliquid_validator_rewards WHERE block_time > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY validator) SELECT s.validator AS validator, s.stake_hype, s.commission_bps, s.delegator_count, r.reward_24h, r1.reward_1h, r.earning_minutes, r.total_minutes, ROUND(r.earning_minutes * 100.0 / r.total_minutes, 2) AS uptime_pct, CASE WHEN s.stake_hype < 100000 THEN 'bench' WHEN r.earning_minutes = 0 THEN 'jailed' WHEN r.earning_minutes < r.total_minutes THEN 'degraded' ELSE 'active' END AS status, ROUND((r.reward_24h * 365 * 100) / NULLIF(s.stake_hype, 0), 2) AS implied_apr_pct, r.last_seen FROM stake s LEFT JOIN rewards24 r ON r.validator = s.validator LEFT JOIN rewards1h r1 ON r1.validator = s.validator ORDER BY s.stake_hype DESC
stakeConcentration: WITH stake AS (SELECT validator, argMax(validator_total_delegated, snapshot_time) / 1e8 AS stake_hype FROM hyperliquid_delegator_rewards WHERE snapshot_time > now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR GROUP BY validator), active AS (SELECT validator, stake_hype FROM stake WHERE stake_hype > 100000), totals AS (SELECT SUM(stake_hype) AS total_active_stake FROM active), ranked AS (SELECT validator, stake_hype, SUM(stake_hype) OVER (ORDER BY stake_hype DESC) AS cumulative_stake, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY stake_hype DESC) AS rank FROM active) SELECT rank, validator, ROUND(stake_hype, 0) AS stake_hype, ROUND(stake_hype * 100.0 / (SELECT total_active_stake FROM totals), 2) AS stake_pct, ROUND(cumulative_stake * 100.0 / (SELECT total_active_stake FROM totals), 2) AS cumulative_pct FROM ranked ORDER BY rank
validatorHeartbeat: SELECT validator, toStartOfMinute(block_time) AS minute, CASE WHEN reward > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS earning FROM hyperliquid_validator_rewards WHERE block_time > now() - INTERVAL 60 MINUTE ORDER BY validator, minute
stakingEvents: SELECT block_time, event_type, is_undelegate, is_finalized, user, validator, amount, block_number, hash FROM hyperliquid_staking_events WHERE block_time > now() - INTERVAL 4 HOUR ORDER BY block_time DESC LIMIT 100
jailHistory: WITH base AS (SELECT validator, block_time, reward, SUM(if(reward > 0, 1, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY validator ORDER BY block_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS earning_count_so_far FROM hyperliquid_validator_rewards), streaks AS (SELECT validator, earning_count_so_far AS streak_id, COUNT(*) AS zero_minutes, MIN(block_time) AS streak_start, MAX(block_time) AS streak_end FROM base WHERE reward = 0 GROUP BY validator, earning_count_so_far) SELECT validator, zero_minutes, zero_minutes / 1440.0 AS days_jailed, streak_start, streak_end FROM streaks WHERE streak_id > 0 AND zero_minutes >= 30 ORDER BY streak_start DESC
blockPulse: SELECT block_number, block_time, fills_count, orders_count, book_diffs_count FROM hyperliquid_blocks WHERE block_time > now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE ORDER BY block_number DESC LIMIT 100
userStakingHistory: SELECT block_time, event_type, is_undelegate, is_finalized, user, validator, amount, block_number, hash FROM hyperliquid_staking_events WHERE user = '{{user}}' AND block_time > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY ORDER BY block_time DESC LIMIT 200
